characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of this model's melee weapons.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 2 inches to this model's Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's Fanged Maw, and that weapon gains Sustained Hits 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of each turn, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While an enemy unit is within 6 inches of this model, subtract 1 from the Hit roll each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, in the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, select one eligible Skaven Infantry or Beast unit from Reserves. Set that unit up wholly within 6 inches of this model and more than 8 inches horizontally away from every enemy model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model makes an Advance move, it can move through enemy Infantry models as if they were not there. After that move ends, roll one D6 for each enemy Infantry unit it moved through. On a 3+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3 mortal wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model targets a Vehicle or Monster, ignore modifiers to its Ballistic Skill and Hit rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time an Advance roll is made for this model, if the unmodified result is 1, this model suffers D3 mortal wounds. Each time a Charge roll made for this model fails, this model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit. Each time this model makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this model is not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches. In addition, at the end of your Movement phase, if this model is wholly within 6 inches of a friendly Knawhole, it can enter the Under-Empire, ignoring every other restriction that would normally prevent it from doing so.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After this model has shot, if one or more Critical Hits were scored with one of its lightning weapon profiles, select one enemy unit hit by that profile. That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds in addition to the normal effects of Warpstone.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, when this model is selected to shoot, it can overcharge its capacitors. If it does, after selecting either the Focused lightning or Forked lightning profile, double that profile's Attacks characteristic until those attacks have been resolved. This model then suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

characteristics.name: Keywords
characteristics.$text: ANTI-INFANTRY 2+, BLAST, INDIRECT FIRE, IGNORES COVER

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Hit roll each time a model in that unit makes an attack. If that unit is Below Half-strength, also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons, to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model scores a Critical Wound against an Infantry unit, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage. That enemy unit can suffer a maximum of 3 mortal wounds per phase as a result of this ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this model Remained Stationary during your previous Movement phase, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Ballistic Skill characteristic and to Hit rolls made for its ranged attacks.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After this model has resolved its attacks with its Ratling warpblaster, select one enemy unit that was hit by that weapon. If 13 or more successful hits were scored against that enemy unit by the Ratling warpblaster during that activation, until the start of your next turn: - Subtract 2 inches from that unit's Move characteristic. - That unit cannot Advance. - That unit cannot make Normal moves outside its own Movement phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time an enemy Vehicle or Monster unit loses one or more wounds as a result of an attack made with this model's Warp-Doom magma cannon, that unit cannot regain lost wounds until your next Command phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After this model has shot, roll one D6. On a 1, this model suffers D3 mortal wounds. If it used Burn-Burn Warpstone when it shot, it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While an enemy unit is within 6 inches of this model, subtract 1 from the Toughness and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit, to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, select one friendly Plague Monks, Plague Censer Bearers or Pestilens Character unit within 6 inches of this model. One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds. If that unit contains no wounded models but is Below its Starting Strength, return destroyed models to it with a combined Wounds characteristic no greater than D3+1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, you can sacrifice D3 friendly Pestilens models within 8 inches of this model. If every selected model is sacrificed, select one friendly Pestilens unit within 8 inches of this model. Until your next Command phase, attacks made by models in that unit score Critical Hits and Critical Wounds on unmodified rolls of 5+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model is destroyed, do not roll to determine whether its Deadly Demise D6 ability triggers; it triggers automatically.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, after this model has shot that phase, select one Warpclaw cannon profile equipped by this model and eligible targets for it. This model can make attacks with that profile one additional time. After resolving those attacks, every other unit within 6 inches of this model suffers D3+3 mortal wounds, then this model suffers D6+3 mortal wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During Declare Battle Formations, this model can be placed in the Under-Empire. When it is selected to emerge, do not make a Passage roll or select an exit. Instead, set it up more than 6 inches horizontally away from every enemy model, then create one friendly Knawhole within 3 inches of it. This model cannot declare a charge in the same turn and cannot enter the Under-Empire again.

characteristics.$text: When this model is destroyed, do not roll to determine whether its Deadly Demise D6 ability triggers; it triggers automatically.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle round, when a friendly Skryre unit within 6 inches of this model suffers mortal wounds as a result of Warpstone backlash, reduce the number of mortal wounds suffered by 2, to a minimum of 0.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, select one other friendly Skaven Vehicle unit within 3 inches of this model. One model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains no Great Clan keyword, passive rule or additional Reactor mode. It can use only Overdrive, Weapons Surge and Meat-Fuel.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains the VERMINUS keyword, its Transport Capacity becomes 60 and its Firing Deck 20 ability is replaced with Firing Deck 30. When a non-CHARACTER VERMINUS INFANTRY unit is returned by They Just Keep Coming!, it can embark within this model instead of entering the Under-Empire, if its full unit can embark without exceeding this model's capacity.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Until your next Command phase, just after this model ends a Normal move, up to three embarked SKAVEN INFANTRY units can disembark. Those units remain eligible to shoot and declare a charge that turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains the MOULDER keyword and can transport MOULDER BEAST units and non-TITANIC MOULDER MONSTER units. Each BEAST model occupies the space of 3 models and each MONSTER model occupies the space of 20 models.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this mode is activated, select one MOULDER BEAST or MONSTER unit embarked within this model or within 6" of it. One model in that unit regains up to D6+3 lost wounds and, until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains the MASTERCLAN keyword. One embarked MASTERCLAN PSYKER can manifest Verminous Spells as if it were on the battlefield, measuring all ranges from this model. Resolve any mortal wounds caused by that PSYKER's Peril against this model instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this mode is activated, select one embarked MASTERCLAN PSYKER. Until your next Command phase, add 1 to that model's manifestation rolls and it can attempt to manifest one additional Verminous Spell.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains the PESTILENS keyword and the Pestilence (Aura) core ability, which has a range of 12". Enemy units within 6" of this model are treated as Below Half-strength for that ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Until your next Command phase, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in enemy units within 12" of this model, and those units cannot regain lost wounds or return destroyed models.

modifiers.value: While an enemy unit is within 12" of this model, subtract 1 from Hit rolls made for that enemy unit. If that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons, to a minimum of 1. Enemy units within 6" of this model are treated as Below Half-strength for this ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains the SKRYRE keyword and has 8 jury-rigged hardpoints instead of 6; the maximum of 2 copies of each hardpoint weapon still applies.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Until your next Command phase, this model's ranged weapons score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. Resolve Warpstone Backlash normally.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each weapon selected for this model's Firing Deck ability has the Hazardous ability while this model makes attacks with it. Every failed Hazardous test made for a weapon used by this model is resolved against this model.

characteristics.$text: When this model is destroyed, do not roll to determine whether its Deadly Demise 2D6 ability triggers; it triggers automatically.

characteristics.$text: During Declare Battle Formations, select exactly one configuration and pay its points cost. This model gains that configuration's Clan keyword, passive rule and additional Reactor mode. Additional modes are activated through Rats For The Reactor! ESHIN cannot be selected.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, select any number of Reactor modes this model has. Each mode can be selected only once per phase. For each selected mode, Sacrifice exactly 3 embarked SKAVENSLAVE and/or CLANRAT models, then resolve that mode. OVERDRIVE: Until your next Command phase, add 6" to this model's Move characteristic. This model is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced, and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and Advance and Charge rolls. WEAPONS SURGE: Until your next Command phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of this model's ranged weapons by 1, and re-roll each roll made to determine their Attacks characteristic. MEAT-FUEL: This model regains up to D3+3 lost wounds.

TYPE: Battle Tactic Stratagem

WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One SKRYRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, and one friendly SKAVEN BATTLELINE unit within 3" of it.

EFFECT: Sacrifice D3 models from that BATTLELINE unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Hit rolls and Wound rolls for ranged attacks made by models in your SKRYRE unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 2CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: Just after a friendly SKRYRE unit uses a once-per-battle Workshop Project.

TARGET: That SKRYRE unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6. On a 1-2, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On a 3+, that Workshop Project can be used one additional time this battle.

RESTRICTION: Once per battle. A Grand Project cannot be selected.

characteristics.$text:

TYPE: Wargear Stratagem

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a SKRYRE unit from your army is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That SKRYRE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit; those weapons also have HAZARDOUS. If a weapon already has HAZARDOUS, subtract 1 from Hazardous tests taken for that weapon instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Strategic Ploy Stratagem

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a SKRYRE INFANTRY unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That SKRYRE INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+2". It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT, end that move within Engagement Range, or declare a charge this turn.

characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: Just after a SKRYRE unit from your army fails one or more Hazardous tests.

TARGET: That SKRYRE unit.

EFFECT: Re-roll any or all failed Hazardous tests from that sequence. If one or more are still failed after those re-rolls, your unit becomes Battle-shocked.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: Just after a SKRYRE VEHICLE model from your army is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield.

TARGET: That destroyed model.

EFFECT: Do not roll for that model's Deadly Demise, Explodes, Catastrophic Warpcore or equivalent destruction ability. That ability automatically triggers. If the damage caused by that ability is determined using one or more dice, you can re-roll those dice.

TARGET: That unit, if it is within 6" of a friendly MOULDER CHARACTER model.

EFFECT: Add 2 to that Advance or Charge roll and re-roll it. After your unit completes that move, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains D3+2 lost wounds. If your unit has the MUTATED keyword, it regains D3+3 lost wounds instead.

characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Battle Tactic Stratagem

WHEN: Just after another friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 6" of a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army is destroyed.

TARGET: That MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, excluding weapons with EXTRA ATTACKS, and one model in your unit regains D3 lost wounds.

characteristics.$text:

TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: When you Flesh-Sculpt a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER using Make-Make New Ones!.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Select one additional Flesh-Sculpting alteration for your unit. Its Vermin modifier applies normally. This can increase a normal creation to 4 alterations, or a masterpiece to 5.

characteristics.$text:

TYPE: Battle Tactic Stratagem

WHEN: Just after a MUTATED unit from your army emerges from the Under-Empire.

TARGET: That MUTATED unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit and melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have LANCE. If your unit is a MONSTER, it can also re-roll Charge rolls this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP/2CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: Just after a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit from your army is selected as the target of one or more melee attacks.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the MUTATED keyword. On a 4+, do not remove that model. After the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, that destroyed model can fight and is then removed from the battlefield.

RESTRICTION: Costs 1CP for a BEAST; 2CP for a MONSTER.

TARGET: One SKAVEN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit gains the ESHIN keyword.

WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ESHIN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit that is the target of a currently revealed Scheme.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your ESHIN unit makes an attack against that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit contains a CHARACTER model, those attacks also have PRECISION.

TARGET: That ESHIN INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Alternatively, if it is within 6" of a friendly Knawhole, it can immediately enter the Under-Empire. A unit that makes the Normal move cannot declare a charge this turn.

CP: 1CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: Your Command phase, when you brew a Plague.

TARGET: One friendly CLANRATS unit within 6" of a PESTILENS CHARACTER model from your army.

EFFECT: Sacrifice up to 3 models from your unit. Reduce the Vermin cost of that Plague by 1 for each model Sacrificed, to a minimum of 0. If two Plagues are being brewed, the reduction applies to only one of them.

characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Strategic Ploy Stratagem

WHEN: Just after an enemy unit becomes INFECTED.

TARGET: One other enemy unit within 6" of that INFECTED unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6. On a 3+, the target also becomes INFECTED.

RESTRICTION: An Infection caused by this Stratagem cannot trigger this Stratagem again.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Epic Deed Stratagem

WHEN: At the start of the Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One INFECTED enemy unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, the target is treated as though it were within range of a friendly Pestilence aura for all purposes, including the normal Pestilence ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Battle Tactic Stratagem

WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a PESTILENS unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.

TARGET: That PESTILENS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+. If the target is a CLANRATS unit with Filth-Filth Carriers, this Feel No Pain cannot prevent wounds or mortal wounds caused by the Plague it carries.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Battle Tactic Stratagem

WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One PESTILENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for melee attacks made by models in your unit. If the target of those attacks is INFECTED, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

characteristics.name: Description

CP: 1CP
TYPE: Strategic Ploy Stratagem

WHEN: Just after a PESTILENS INFANTRY unit from your army is destroyed.

TARGET: That destroyed unit.

EFFECT: Before removing its last model, place one Plague Corpse marker as close as possible to that model. Until the start of your next Command phase, enemy units within 3" of that marker are treated as though they were within Pestilence range for the purposes of the currently brewed Plague. A unit can only be affected by one Plague Corpse marker at a time.

TARGET: That VERMINUS CHARACTER unit and one friendly CLANRATS unit within 3" of it.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack would be allocated to a model in your VERMINUS CHARACTER unit, if the selected CLANRATS unit is an eligible target for that attack, allocate that attack to the CLANRATS unit instead.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Sacrifice up to D3 models from your unit. For each model Sacrificed: if Advancing, add 1" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase; if charging, add 1 to its Charge roll. If 3 models were Sacrificed, also re-roll that Advance or Charge roll.

characteristics.$text:

TARGET: One UNDER COMMAND CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack against an enemy unit within Engagement Range of two or more other friendly SKAVEN units, add 1 to the Wound roll and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:

TYPE: Strategic Ploy Stratagem

WHEN: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of a friendly CLANRATS unit.

TARGET: One friendly STORMVERMIN unit from the same Clawpack that is within 6" of that CLANRATS unit and is not within Engagement Range.

EFFECT: Your STORMVERMIN unit can immediately declare a charge that targets only that enemy unit. If the charge is successful, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have LANCE until the end of the turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:

WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an UNDER COMMAND CLANRATS unit from your army loses one or more models.

TARGET: That CLANRATS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 6+. In addition, when determining whether your unit contains 10 or 20 models for Ranks Upon Ranks or Warlord Commands, treat it as containing 5 additional models.

characteristics.$text:
CP: 1CP
TYPE: Strategic Ploy Stratagem

TARGET: One UNDER COMMAND CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit from your army that is currently affected by a Warlord Command.

EFFECT: Replace that Warlord Command with a different Warlord Command. The new Command lasts for the normal duration. If your unit has Red-Toothed Veterans, replace only one of its Commands.

characteristics.$text:

TYPE: Strategic Ploy Stratagem

TARGET: One eligible INFANTRY, MOUNTED or RATTLETRAP VEHICLE unit from your army that is wholly within 6" of a friendly Knawhole and is not within Engagement Range.

EFFECT: Return your unit to the Under-Empire. It cannot emerge during the same battle round.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have IGNORES COVER.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:

TARGET: One RATTLETRAP VEHICLE unit from your army that emerged from the Under-Empire this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

TYPE: Battle Tactic Stratagem

TARGET: One SKURVY unit from your army, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units, that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit, excluding BLAST weapons, have CLOSE-QUARTERS.

infoLinks.name: Big-Big Guns For Big-Big Rats! (3 Workshop Tokens)

sharedRules.name: Scurry Away!
sharedRules.description:
Cornered Rats: Each time this unit fails a Battle-shock test, roll one D6. This unit suffers mortal wounds equal to the result. If it is not destroyed, each remaining model can make a move up to that many inches, can move within Engagement Range, cannot end closer to any enemy model, must end as far away as possible from the closest enemy model, and the unit must end in Unit Coherency.

Live to Fight-Flee Another Day: When this unit is selected to Fall Back, it can use this rule instead. Roll one D6 and this unit suffers that many mortal wounds. If it is not destroyed, each model can move up to that many inches, can move within Engagement Range, and must end farther away from every enemy unit it was within Engagement Range of. After the move this unit is Battle-shocked and does not trigger Cornered Rats. Until the end of the turn it is treated as though it had not Fallen Back.

sharedRules.name: Better Them-Than Me!
sharedRules.description: Some SKAVEN CHARACTER units have a uniquely named ability beginning Better Them-Than Me! Rules that refer to Better Them-Than Me! refer to any such ability. Each one specifies its timing, which friendly models can be Sacrificed, how many models must be Sacrificed, and the benefit gained.

sharedRules.name: Sacrifice
sharedRules.description: When a rule instructs you to Sacrifice one or more models, select the exact number of eligible friendly models and destroy them. No saving throw or rule can prevent that destruction. If the required models cannot be destroyed, the Sacrifice fails and its benefit is not gained. Unless a rule states otherwise, only models on the battlefield can be Sacrificed.

sharedRules.name: Warpstone
sharedRules.description: Each time a Critical Hit is scored with a WARPSTONE weapon, add 2 to that attack’s Strength and improve its Armour Penetration by 2. After the unit finishes making its attacks, if one or more WARPSTONE Critical Hits were scored, roll one D6; on a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Resolve this backlash once regardless of how many Critical Hits were scored.

sharedRules.name: Pestilence
sharedRules.description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of one or more friendly PESTILENS units, subtract 1 from Hit rolls made for that enemy unit. If that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons, to a minimum of 1.

sharedRules.name: Verminous Casting
sharedRules.description: A model’s Psyker Level determines how many Verminous Spells it can attempt to manifest. Select an available spell, roll 2D6 and compare the result with its casting value. If the result equals or exceeds that value, the spell is successfully manifested. A double 6 automatically succeeds and cannot be unbound. Unless otherwise stated, each Verminous Spell can successfully resolve once per army per battle round.

sharedRules.name: Perils
sharedRules.description: A manifestation roll suffers Perils if its total is 4 or less, or if both dice are 1. The caster’s unit immediately suffers 13 mortal wounds after the manifestation roll and before the spell resolves.

sharedRules.name: Psyker Level 1
sharedRules.description: This unit has Psyker Level 1. Its Psyker Level determines how many Verminous Spells it can attempt to manifest.

sharedRules.name: Psyker Level 2
sharedRules.description: This unit has Psyker Level 2. Its Psyker Level determines how many Verminous Spells it can attempt to manifest.

sharedRules.name: Psyker Level 3
sharedRules.description: This unit has Psyker Level 3. Its Psyker Level determines how many Verminous Spells it can attempt to manifest.

sharedRules.name: Terrifying Monstrosity
sharedRules.description: Listed as a CORE ability on the source datasheet. Codex: Skaven 0.10.4 does not provide a separate shared-rule definition for it.

sharedRules.name: The Great Workshops
sharedRules.description: During Muster Armies, purchase Workshop Projects using Workshop Tokens: Incursion (1,000 points): 6; Strike Force (2,000 points): 12; Onslaught (3,000 points): 18. Unspent tokens are lost when the battle begins.

sharedRules.name: Assigning Workshop Projects
sharedRules.description: Record each assigned Project on your Army Roster. Its unit gains SKRYRE if it does not already have it. Each unit can have no more than 2 Projects; each named Project can be purchased once per army. Projects are not Enhancements. Unassigned Projects, such as Hidden Workshop and Doomsphere, do not count toward a unit's Project limit.

sharedRules.name: Make-Make New Ones!
sharedRules.description: Your They Just Keep Coming! Vermin Ability can also target destroyed non-CHARACTER MOULDER BEAST units. When a new MOULDER BEAST unit is created this way, you can Flesh-Sculpt it before placing it in the Under-Empire. That new unit gains the MUTATED keyword.

sharedRules.name: Monstrous Creations
sharedRules.description: Your They Just Keep Coming! Vermin Ability can also target destroyed non-CHARACTER MOULDER MONSTER units. When it does, roll the Vermin cost normally, then double the final rolled cost. If Thirteen for the Horned Rat is used instead, Sacrifice exactly 26 eligible friendly SKAVEN models instead of 13. Flesh-Sculpting costs must still be paid using Vermin. The created MONSTER can be placed in and emerge from the Under-Empire despite being a MONSTER. This exception applies only to the unit created by They Just Keep Coming! and does not otherwise allow that MONSTER to enter the Under-Empire.

sharedRules.name: Remade Clanrats
sharedRules.description: When They Just Keep Coming! creates a new CLANRATS unit, you can Flesh-Sculpt that unit before placing it in the Under-Empire. That unit gains the MOULDER and MUTATED keywords, can receive a maximum of one Flesh-Sculpting alteration, and cannot select Bloated Mass or Withered Frame.

sharedRules.name: Moulder Character Ability
sharedRules.description: Every MOULDER CHARACTER model from your army has this ability. Fresh Meat-Meat!: At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly MOULDER BEAST, MOULDER MONSTER or CLANRATS unit within 6" of this model, then select one other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 3" of this model. You can Sacrifice up to 3 models from that SKAVEN INFANTRY unit. If the first selected unit is a CLANRATS unit, for each model Sacrificed, return one destroyed Clanrat model to that unit, not exceeding its Starting Strength. Otherwise, for each model Sacrificed, one model in the first selected unit regains 1 lost wound. Each eligible unit can only be selected as the first selected unit for this ability once per phase.

sharedRules.name: Flesh-Sculpting
sharedRules.description: When Make-Make New Ones! creates an eligible unit, select Flesh-Sculpting alterations for it. MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER units can receive a maximum of 3 alterations; CLANRATS can receive a maximum of 1. Each characteristic can only be altered once.

sharedRules.name: Flesh-Sculpting Costs and Limits
sharedRules.description: After selecting alterations, total their Vermin modifiers. If the total is positive, spend that many additional Vermin. If the total is 0 or less, no additional Vermin are spent. Flesh-Sculpting can never generate Vermin. Flesh-Sculpting costs cannot be paid using Thirteen for the Horned Rat. Move, Toughness, Wounds and Objective Control cannot be reduced below 1. Save cannot be improved beyond 3+. Melee Weapon Skill cannot be improved beyond 3+. Melee Attacks cannot be reduced below 1.

sharedRules.name: Mutated - Unstable Mutation
sharedRules.description: EFFECT: A unit created using Make-Make New Ones! gains the MUTATED keyword and this ability. This unit has DEADLY DEMISE D6. If it already had a Deadly Demise ability, replace it with DEADLY DEMISE D6. Each time this unit's Deadly Demise ability activates, after resolving that ability, gain D6 Vermin.

sharedRules.name: Secret Schemes
sharedRules.description: After both players have deployed their armies, secretly select and record 4 different Schemes. At the start of your Command phase, you can reveal one unrevealed Scheme; it remains active until completed or the battle ends. Multiple Schemes can be active. Each Scheme can be completed once, to a maximum of 4 completions per battle; resolve its Payment immediately.

sharedRules.name: Black Contracts
sharedRules.description: At the start of the first battle round, before any Scout moves are made, select up to 3 CLANRATS units from your army. Those units gain the ESHIN keyword and the following ability until the end of the battle. Paid Informants: This unit has SCOUTS 6".

sharedRules.name: Brewing The Plague
sharedRules.description: At the start of your Command phase, you can brew one Plague. Select one Plague from the Plague Catalogue and pay its listed Vermin cost. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Plague is active and modifies the Pestilence auras of friendly PESTILENS units. You cannot brew the same Plague in consecutive battle rounds.

sharedRules.name: Spread-Spread The Plague!
sharedRules.description: Each time an enemy unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks made by a PESTILENS unit, after the attacking unit has finished making those attacks, if that enemy unit lost one or more wounds as a result, roll one D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit becomes INFECTED until the start of your next Command phase. Each enemy unit can only be tested for Infection once per phase.

sharedRules.name: Infected
sharedRules.description: An INFECTED unit is treated as though it were within range of a friendly Pestilence aura for the purposes of the currently brewed Plague, regardless of its actual distance from friendly PESTILENS units. Being INFECTED does not by itself apply the normal Pestilence ability unless another rule states otherwise.

sharedRules.name: Virulent Proximity
sharedRules.description: At the start of each Fight phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within range of one or more friendly Pestilence auras. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. A unit can only be affected by Virulent Proximity once per Fight phase.

sharedRules.name: Filth-Filth Carriers
sharedRules.description: At the start of the first battle round, before any Scout moves are made, select up to 3 CLANRATS units from your army. Those units gain the PESTILENS keyword and the following ability until the end of the battle. Plague Carrier: This unit has a 3" Pestilence aura. That aura carries the currently brewed Plague, but this unit does not gain the normal Pestilence ability. For the purposes of the currently brewed Plague and Virulent Proximity, this unit is also treated as though it were an enemy unit within range of a friendly Pestilence aura.

sharedRules.name: The Weeping Pox (2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: While an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1 and Battle-shock tests taken for that unit cannot be re-rolled.

sharedRules.name: The Red Death (3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Each time a model in a PESTILENS unit makes a melee attack against an enemy unit within Pestilence range, an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

sharedRules.name: The Crawling Ague (3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within Pestilence range subtract 2" from their Move characteristic, subtract 2 from Advance rolls, and subtract 2 from Charge rolls. Multiple instances do not stack.

sharedRules.name: The Black Rot (4 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move while within Pestilence range, roll one D6. On a 4+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. A unit can only suffer these mortal wounds once per phase.

sharedRules.name: The Withering Sickness (4 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: While an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of its melee weapons. If that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1.

sharedRules.name: Nurglitch's Gift (5 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: When this Plague is brewed, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within Pestilence range. On a 2+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, subtract 1 from its Toughness characteristic, it cannot regain lost wounds, and destroyed models cannot be returned to that unit.

sharedRules.name: Clawpacks
sharedRules.description: During the Declare Battle Formations step, you can organize eligible units into Clawpacks. Each Clawpack consists of one VERMINUS CHARACTER unit and up to 3 CLANRATS and/or STORMVERMIN units. Each unit can belong to only one Clawpack. A CHARACTER does not need to Lead a unit in its Clawpack.

sharedRules.name: Under Command
sharedRules.description: While a CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit is within 9" of its Clawpack's CHARACTER unit, that unit is UNDER COMMAND.

sharedRules.name: Yes-Yes, Warlord!
sharedRules.description: At the start of your Command phase, each VERMINUS CHARACTER commanding a Clawpack can issue one Warlord Command to one UNDER COMMAND unit from its Clawpack. That Command lasts until the start of your next Command phase. A unit can normally only be affected by one Warlord Command at a time.

sharedRules.name: Kill-Kill Them!
sharedRules.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If this unit contains 10 or more models, also re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

sharedRules.name: Move-Move, Cowards!
sharedRules.description: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 2 to Advance rolls made for it.

sharedRules.name: Hold-Hold Or Die!
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit. While this unit contains 10 or more models, it can re-roll Battle-shock tests.

sharedRules.name: Stab-Stab From Behind!
sharedRules.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack against an enemy unit that is also within Engagement Range of another friendly SKAVEN unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: Shields Up-Up!
sharedRules.description: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit, that model has the Benefit of Cover. If this unit already has the Benefit of Cover, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 instead.

sharedRules.name: Ranks Upon Ranks
sharedRules.description: While a CLANRATS unit is UNDER COMMAND and contains 10 or more models, improve its Leadership characteristic by 1 and add 1 to Hit rolls for melee attacks made by models in that unit. While it contains 20 or more models, also add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of its models.

sharedRules.name: Black-Furred Elite
sharedRules.description: While a STORMVERMIN unit is UNDER COMMAND, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack against an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more friendly CLANRATS units, add 1 to the Wound roll.

sharedRules.name: No Run-Run! Fight-Fight!
sharedRules.description: Once per battle round, when an UNDER COMMAND CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit fails a Battle-shock test, its Clawpack CHARACTER can enforce discipline if it is within 9". If it does, Sacrifice D3 models from that unit. That Battle-shock test is then treated as having been passed.

sharedRules.name: The First Breach
sharedRules.description: During your first Movement phase, one eligible unit can emerge from the Under-Empire even if the mission prevents Reserves from arriving during the first battle round. That unit must still make its Passage roll and obey the normal emergence placement rules.

sharedRules.name: Endless Passages
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Under-Empire Passage roll. You must use the new result.

sharedRules.name: Surging From Below
sharedRules.description: Each time a friendly unit emerges from the Under-Empire, it gains the relevant benefit below until the end of the turn. INFANTRY, MOUNTED & BEAST +1 to Hit rolls for ranged attacks. Melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have LANCE. VEHICLE That unit counts as having Remained Stationary. MONSTER & TITANIC No benefit, unless another rule explicitly allows that unit to enter the Under-Empire.

sharedRules.name: Daemonic Conduits
sharedRules.description: Each time a friendly SKAVEN non-DAEMON PSYKER attempts to manifest a Verminous Spell, it can select one visible friendly SKAVEN DAEMON within 13" as its conduit. If it does, add 1 to the manifestation roll. Measure that spell's range and visibility from either the caster or the conduit. If that manifestation causes Peril, the mortal wounds caused by that Peril are suffered by the conduit instead of the caster's unit. Each SKAVEN DAEMON unit can be selected as a conduit only once per turn.

sharedRules.name: The Thirteenth Toll
sharedRules.description: Each time a Verminous Spell manifested through a Daemonic Conduit has a final manifestation result of 13 or more, until your next Command phase add 1 to Hit rolls made for that conduit.

sharedRules.name: Keeping Plunder
sharedRules.description: Each SKURVY unit begins the battle with 0 Plunder. Record each unit's Plunder separately. When a unit is destroyed, its Plunder is lost.

sharedRules.name: Plundering Objectives
sharedRules.description: In your Movement phase, just after a SKURVY unit from your army ends a Normal move, if it is not Battle-shocked, it can Plunder one objective marker within range that has not been Plundered by your army this turn. If it does, that unit gains 3 Plunder and cannot declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Spoils Of Battle
sharedRules.description: Each time a SKURVY unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, it gains 1 Plunder.

sharedRules.name: Spending Plunder
sharedRules.description: At the end of your Command phase, each SKURVY unit from your army that is on the battlefield and is not Battle-shocked can purchase one option from the Plunder Table. Spend the listed amount of that unit's Plunder. Unless otherwise stated, that option lasts until the start of your next Command phase. A unit can have no more than two different Plunder options active at the same time.

sharedRules.name: Black-Flag Clanrats
sharedRules.description: CLANRATS units from your army gain the SKURVY keyword and the following ability. Claim-Claim the Prize!: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

sharedRules.name: Black-Flag Mercenaries
sharedRules.description: When mustering your army, you can include units from Index: Black-Flag. Their combined points value cannot exceed half of your army's points limit. Each unit included this way gains the SKURVY keyword.

sharedRules.name: Rise-Rise Above Them!
sharedRules.description: Every friendly STORMVERMIN unit has a Supremacy Rank and begins the battle at Rank 1. Each time a friendly STORMVERMIN unit destroys one or more enemy units in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after that unit has finished making its attacks, increase its Supremacy Rank by 1, to a maximum of 3. Each time a friendly STORMVERMIN unit fails a Battle-shock test, reduce its Supremacy Rank by 1, to a minimum of 0. Supremacy Rank benefits are cumulative.

sharedRules.name: Rank 1 - Black-Furred Elite
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit.

sharedRules.name: Rank 2 - Best-Best Warriors
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by models in this unit.

sharedRules.name: Rank 3 - Lords of the Lesser Rats
sharedRules.description: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. This unit can re-roll Battle-shock tests.

sharedRules.name: The Horned Rat Whispers
sharedRules.description: At the start of each battle round, roll 3D6 and set those dice aside. These are your Prophecy dice for that battle round. Each time a friendly GREY SEER model makes a Manifestation roll, after rolling the dice but before resolving that roll, you can replace one of those dice with one unused Prophecy die. If you do, that Prophecy die is expended and its value is treated as part of the unmodified Manifestation roll for all rules purposes. After that manifestation attempt has been resolved, that GREY SEER model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. At the end of the battle round, discard all unused Prophecy dice.

sharedRules.name: Twist-Twist Fate!
sharedRules.description: Before replacing a Manifestation die with a Prophecy die, you can spend 1 Vermin. If you do, increase or decrease that Prophecy die by 1, to a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 6. Each Prophecy die can only be modified in this way once.

sharedRules.name: Drive the Engines Hard
sharedRules.description: Add 2 to Advance rolls made for friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE units. Friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE units are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Advanced.

sharedRules.name: Engine Strain
sharedRules.description: At the end of your Shooting phase, for each friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE unit that Advanced this turn and was selected to shoot this phase, roll one D6. On a 1-2, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Clan Allegiance
sharedRules.description: For the purposes of this Detachment, the following are Clan keywords: VERMINUS, SKRYRE, MOULDER, ESHIN, PESTILENS and SKURVY. If a unit has more than one Clan keyword, when mustering your army select one of those keywords to be that unit's Clan Allegiance for the battle. Otherwise, a unit's Clan Allegiance is its Clan keyword.

sharedRules.name: Work-Work Together! For Now...
sharedRules.description: Each time a friendly unit with a Clan Allegiance is selected to shoot or fight, select one enemy unit as the target of its attacks. If that enemy unit has already lost one or more wounds during that phase as a result of attacks made by a friendly unit with a different Clan Allegiance, add 1 to Hit rolls made by the attacking unit against that enemy unit until the end of the phase. A Clan Allegiance cannot enable this benefit for another unit with the same Clan Allegiance.

sharedRules.name: Mine-Mine Was the Plan!
sharedRules.description: Once per phase, when a friendly unit destroys an enemy unit while benefiting from Work-Work Together! For Now..., gain 1 Vermin.

sharedRules.name: Army Rule — Vermin
sharedRules.description: If your Army Faction is SKAVEN, you have a Vermin pool. It starts the battle at 0 and Vermin remains in the pool until spent.

sharedRules.name: Gaining Vermin
sharedRules.description:
• The Swarm Grows — start of your Command phase: D3.
• Death Breeds Life — just after a friendly SKAVEN unit is destroyed: D3.
• Panic-Panic! — just after a friendly SKAVEN unit fails a Battle-shock test: D3.
• They Are Everywhere! — just after a friendly SKAVEN unit successfully emerges from the Under-Empire: D3.
• Disturb the Nest — just after a friendly Knawhole is destroyed: D3.
• Waste-Waste Them! — first time one or more friendly models are Sacrificed in each phase: D3.
• Feed the Swarm — just after a friendly SKAVEN unit destroys an enemy unit: D3.
• Take-Take Everything! — just after you gain control of a neutral objective while one or more friendly SKAVEN units are within range: D3.

sharedRules.name: Paying A Rolled Cost
sharedRules.description: For an XD3 Vermin cost, roll the specified D3, apply cost modifiers, then spend that much Vermin. You cannot voluntarily pay less.

sharedRules.name: Thirteen For The Horned Rat
sharedRules.description: If you cannot pay a full Vermin cost, you can instead Sacrifice exactly 13 eligible friendly SKAVEN models. The entire modified cost is then considered paid.

sharedRules.name: Vermin Ability Limits
sharedRules.description: Each Vermin Ability can be used once per turn; different Vermin Abilities can be used in the same turn. A passed timing window cannot be banked.

sharedRules.name: Rattletrap Surcharge
sharedRules.description: If a Vermin Ability targets a RATTLETRAP unit, increase its rolled Vermin cost by 3.

sharedRules.name: Vermin Abilities
sharedRules.description:
• MORE-MORE BODIES! — 2D3 Vermin, end of your Command phase. Return up to 13 wounds worth of destroyed models to one below-Starting-Strength SKAVEN INFANTRY unit, using a 4D3+1 wound budget.
• FROM BELOW-BELOW! — 2D3 Vermin, just after a Passage roll and before resolving it. Add 1 to that Passage roll; an unmodified 1 cannot be modified.
• MENACE BELOW — 2D3 Vermin, end of your Reinforcements step. Add a new minimum-sized CLANRAT unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Knawhole and more than 8" from enemies. It cannot later be selected for They Just Keep Coming!
• KNAW, KNAW, KNAW! — 3D3 Vermin, end of your Reinforcements step. Create one friendly KNAWHOLE more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model.
• THEY JUST KEEP COMING! — 4D3 Vermin, just after an eligible friendly non-CHARACTER SKAVEN INFANTRY, MOUNTED, or RATTLETRAP VEHICLE unit is destroyed. Add an identical new unit at Starting Strength and place it in the Under-Empire.
• OVER THEIR CORPSES! — 3D3 Vermin, Fight phase after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit is destroyed. One other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 6" can Surge up to 6" and, if eligible, fight.
• TAKE THEM WITH US-US! — 3D3 Vermin, after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit is destroyed in Engagement Range. Roll one D6 per 5 models it had at the start of the phase, max 6D6; each 4+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on one enemy unit that was engaged with it.
• THEY'RE IN THE WALLS! — 1D3 Vermin, opponent's Movement phase after an enemy Normal/Advance/Fall Back move ends within 13" of an unused friendly Knawhole. Select a friendly unit in the Under-Empire and roll D6: 1-3 it is destroyed and Death Breeds Life gives D6 Vermin; 4+ it emerges wholly within 6" of that Knawhole and more than 8" from enemies.

sharedRules.name: More-More Bodies! (2D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: End of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit that is below its Starting Strength. EFFECT: Roll 4D3+1. Return destroyed models to that unit whose combined Wounds characteristics do not exceed the result. You cannot return more than 13 wounds' worth of models, and the unit cannot be returned above its Starting Strength.

sharedRules.name: From Below-Below! (2D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: Just after making a Passage roll for a friendly unit, before resolving that roll. EFFECT: Add 1 to that Passage roll. An unmodified roll of 1 cannot be modified by this ability.

sharedRules.name: Menace Below (2D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: End of your Reinforcements step. EFFECT: Add one new minimum-sized CLANRAT unit to your army and set it up wholly within 6" of a friendly Knawhole and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. RESTRICTIONS: A unit created by this ability cannot subsequently be selected for They Just Keep Coming!

sharedRules.name: Knaw, Knaw, Knaw! (3D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: End of your Reinforcements step. EFFECT: Create one friendly KNAWHOLE more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. That Knawhole immediately begins using all rules that normally apply to Knawholes.

sharedRules.name: They Just Keep Coming! (4D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: Just after an eligible friendly unit is destroyed, after resolving Death Breeds Life. TARGET: That destroyed unit, if it was a non-CHARACTER SKAVEN INFANTRY unit, a non-CHARACTER SKAVEN MOUNTED unit, or a non-CHARACTER RATTLETRAP VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Add an identical new unit to your army at its Starting Strength and place it in the Under-Empire. RESTRICTIONS: Units created by Menace Below cannot be selected. This ability can only target the unit whose destruction triggered this ability.

sharedRules.name: Over Their Corpses! (3D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit is destroyed. TARGET: One other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 6" of where that unit was destroyed. EFFECT: The target can make a Surge move of up to 6". During this move, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models and can end that move within Engagement Range. If it has not already fought this phase, it is eligible to fight this phase.

sharedRules.name: Take Them With Us-Us! (3D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: Just after a friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit is destroyed while within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. TARGET: One enemy unit that was within Engagement Range of that destroyed unit. EFFECT: Roll one D6 for every 5 models that were in the destroyed unit at the start of that phase, to a maximum of 6D6. For each roll of 4+, the target suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: They're In The Walls! (1D3 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 13" of an unused friendly Knawhole. EFFECT: Select one friendly unit in the Under-Empire and roll one D6. 1-3: Lost-Lost! That unit is destroyed. Resolve rules triggered by its destruction normally. When resolving Death Breeds Life for that destruction, gain D6 Vermin instead of D3. 4+: From the Walls! That unit emerges wholly within 6" of that Knawhole and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. That Knawhole is considered to have been used that phase, regardless of the result.

sharedRules.name: Under-Empire
sharedRules.description: Units in the Under-Empire are considered to be in Reserves and are affected by rules that refer to Reserves unless stated otherwise. They are not assigned to specific Knawholes.

sharedRules.name: Muster Below
sharedRules.description: During Declare Battle Formations, any number of otherwise eligible SKAVEN units can be placed in the Under-Empire instead of being deployed normally. They ignore normal limits on the number or total points of units beginning in Reserves.

sharedRules.name: Open The First Entrances
sharedRules.description: At the start of Deployment, roll D3 and place that many friendly 30mm Knawhole tokens. Each must be more than 8" from your opponent's deployment zone.

sharedRules.name: No Surface Army / No Reserve Deadline
sharedRules.description: You do not lose solely because you have no models on the battlefield while one or more units remain in the Under-Empire. Units below are not destroyed for failing to arrive before a normal Reserves deadline.

sharedRules.name: Restricted Units
sharedRules.description: First-battle-round Reserve restrictions still apply unless another rule explicitly says otherwise. MONSTER and TITANIC units cannot begin the battle in, enter, or emerge from the Under-Empire unless another rule explicitly permits it.

sharedRules.name: Enter The Under-Empire
sharedRules.description: In your Movement phase, select one friendly SKAVEN unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Knawhole and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. Remove it and place it in the Under-Empire. A unit that entered this turn cannot make a Passage roll this turn.

sharedRules.name: Passage Through The Under-Empire
sharedRules.description:
During your Reinforcements step, select one eligible unit in the Under-Empire and one friendly Knawhole. Make one Passage roll for that unit.
1 — Lost Below: the travelling unit is destroyed and you gain D6 Vermin.
2-3 — Wrong Turn: randomly determine a friendly Knawhole as the exit.
4+ — Found It: the selected Knawhole is the exit.

sharedRules.name: Emerging
sharedRules.description: Set the travelling unit up wholly within 6" of the resolved Knawhole and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. It counts as having made a Normal move and cannot make another Normal, Advance or Fall Back move that phase or Remain Stationary, but can otherwise act normally, including shooting and charging. If the exit is illegal, try another friendly Knawhole; if none allows a legal setup, destroy the unit and gain D6 Vermin. With no friendly Knawholes, units below remain safely there.

sharedRules.name: Knawholes
sharedRules.description:
M - / T 2 / Sv 2++ / W 1 / Ld - / OC 0. A Knawhole cannot move or make attacks. It cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 12". It can be selected for melee attacks while enemy models are within Engagement Range.
Spreading Tunnels: at the start of your Command phase in battle rounds 2-5, you can Sacrifice exactly 13 friendly SKAVEN models to create D3+1 Knawholes, each more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model.
Destroyed Knawholes: resolve Disturb the Nest; units in the Under-Empire are unaffected. A destroyed Knawhole cannot be selected for They Just Keep Coming!
Gnawdrill Excavator: the Gnawdrill is not a 30mm Knawhole token; its datasheet specifies when it functions as a Knawhole.

sharedRules.name: Scurry Away!
sharedRules.description: Cornered Rats and Live to Fight-Flee Another Day are the faction's panic/escape rules. See the Scurry Away! rule entry on affected units for the full reference text.

sharedRules.name: Better Them-Than Me! / Sacrifice
sharedRules.description: Some SKAVEN CHARACTER units have uniquely named Better Them-Than Me! abilities. Each specifies its own timing, eligible models, amount Sacrificed and benefit. Sacrificed models are destroyed without saves or prevention; if the required models cannot be destroyed, the Sacrifice fails.

sharedRules.name: Warpstone
sharedRules.description: Critical Hits with WARPSTONE weapons gain +2 Strength and +2 AP. After that unit finishes making attacks, if one or more Warpstone Critical Hits were scored, roll D6; on 3+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Burn-Burn Warpstone!
sharedRules.description: Once per battle when selected to shoot or fight, until it has finished making attacks, Warpstone weapons equipped by that unit score Critical Hits on unmodified 4+. Resolve normal Warpstone backlash; after those attacks the unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Verminous Casting
sharedRules.description: Psyker Level determines how many Verminous Spells a model can attempt. Select an available spell, roll 2D6, and meet or exceed its casting value. Double 6 automatically succeeds and cannot be unbound. Unless otherwise stated, each Verminous Spell successfully resolves once per army per battle round.

sharedRules.name: Perils
sharedRules.description: A manifestation roll suffers Perils on a total of 4 or less, or on double 1. The caster's unit immediately suffers 13 mortal wounds after the manifestation roll and before the spell resolves.

sharedRules.name: Warp Lightning
sharedRules.description: Range 24", A D6+3, BS 2+, S 10, AP -2, D 3; BLAST, IGNORES COVER, PSYCHIC. This is the basic psychic ranged weapon and is not a Verminous Spell.

sharedRules.name: Pestilence
sharedRules.description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of one or more friendly PESTILENS units, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls. If it is Below Half-strength, also subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of its weapons, to a minimum of 1.

sharedRules.name: Verminjutsu X"
sharedRules.description: Some ESHIN units have Verminjutsu X". While not within Engagement Range, they cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within X". Making attacks does not end this protection.

sharedRules.name: Kill-Kill The Head
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one enemy CHARACTER model. COMPLETION That model is destroyed by an ESHIN unit. PAYMENT Gain D3+1 Vermin and 1CP.

sharedRules.name: Burn-Burn Their Toys
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit. COMPLETION An ESHIN unit causes that unit to become Below Half-strength or destroys it. PAYMENT Gain D3+1 Vermin. Until the end of the battle, each time an ESHIN model makes an attack that targets an enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Steal-Steal The Secrets
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one objective marker in No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone. COMPLETION At the end of your turn, you control that marker and one or more ESHIN INFANTRY units are within range of it. PAYMENT Gain D3+1 Vermin. One ESHIN unit within range of that objective can immediately enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Knawhole.

sharedRules.name: Cut-Cut The Supply
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one enemy non-CHARACTER unit. COMPLETION An ESHIN unit causes that enemy unit to lose one or more wounds during your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. PAYMENT Gain D3 Vermin. Until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 2" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic, it cannot Advance, and it cannot be removed from the battlefield and set up again by an ability.

sharedRules.name: Nothing-Nothing Was Here
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one ESHIN unit. COMPLETION That unit ends your turn wholly within the enemy deployment zone and is not within Engagement Range. PAYMENT That unit can immediately enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Knawhole. Gain D3 Vermin.

sharedRules.name: Silence The Witnesses
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one enemy INFANTRY unit. COMPLETION That unit is destroyed by one or more ESHIN units. PAYMENT Gain D3 Vermin. Select one ESHIN INFANTRY unit from your army that made one or more attacks against that enemy unit during the phase in which it was destroyed. That unit can immediately make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 6".

sharedRules.name: Sabotage-Sabotage!
sharedRules.description: REVEAL Select one objective marker in No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone. COMPLETION At the end of your turn, you control that objective, one or more ESHIN INFANTRY units are within range of it, and at least one such unit is not within Engagement Range. PAYMENT Gain D3 Vermin. That objective becomes Sabotaged until the start of your next Command phase. While Sabotaged, enemy models within range have OC 0, and each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range, roll one D6; on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Stolen Ammo (1 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have IGNORES COVER.

sharedRules.name: Extra-Extra Dakka! (1 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have SUSTAINED HITS 1.

sharedRules.name: Grav-Hooks And Boosters (1 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

sharedRules.name: Shiny-Shiny Shields! (2 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If they already have an invulnerable save, improve it by 1, to a maximum of 4+.

sharedRules.name: Targeting Gubbins (2 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1, to a maximum of 2+.

sharedRules.name: Stolen Combat Drugs (2 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, excluding weapons with EXTRA ATTACKS. Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

sharedRules.name: Warp-Charged Munitions (3 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. Those weapons have WARPSTONE.

sharedRules.name: The Really Good Stuff (3 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Select two different 1-Plunder options. This unit gains both.

sharedRules.name: Aeldari Grav-Drives (4 Plunder)
sharedRules.description: Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

sharedRules.name: Lengthened Legs (+1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Add 2" to Move.

sharedRules.name: Stunted Legs (-1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Subtract 2" from Move.

sharedRules.name: Thickened Hide (+2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Add 1 Toughness.

sharedRules.name: Soft Flesh (-2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 Toughness.

sharedRules.name: Chitinous Plates (+2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Improve Save by 1.

sharedRules.name: Exposed Organs (-2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Worsen Save by 1.

sharedRules.name: Bloated Mass (+1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Add 1 Wound.

sharedRules.name: Withered Frame (-1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 Wound.

sharedRules.name: Grasping Limbs (+1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Add 1 Objective Control.

sharedRules.name: Uncontrollable (-1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 Objective Control.

sharedRules.name: Predatory Reflexes (+2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

sharedRules.name: Sluggish Reflexes (-2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Worsen the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

sharedRules.name: Overgrown Musculature (+1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.

sharedRules.name: Atrophied Musculature (-1 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.

sharedRules.name: Too Many Limbs (+2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. Weapons with EXTRA ATTACKS are not affected.

sharedRules.name: Missing Limbs (-2 Vermin)
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, to a minimum of 1. Weapons with EXTRA ATTACKS are not affected.

sharedRules.name: Jury-Rigged Warplock Optics (1 Workshop Token)
sharedRules.description: BATTLELINE unit with one or more ranged weapons Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

sharedRules.name: Scrap-Welded Armour (1 Workshop Token)
sharedRules.description: BATTLELINE unit Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit, improve that model's Save characteristic by 1 against that attack. Subtract 1" from this unit's Move characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Shock-Collar Motivators (1 Workshop Token)
sharedRules.description: BATTLELINE unit Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic. Each time this unit fails a Battle-shock test, you can re-roll that test. If that re-roll is also failed, this unit suffers D3 additional mortal wounds before resolving any other effects of that failed test.

sharedRules.name: Gyroscopic Targeting Rig (1 Workshop Token)
sharedRules.description: WEAPON TEAM unit Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have HEAVY. Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack with a HEAVY weapon while this unit is benefiting from HEAVY, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

sharedRules.name: Warp-Fed Drive (1 Workshop Token)
sharedRules.description: SKAVEN VEHICLE unit Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

sharedRules.name: Warpstone Stockpile (1 Workshop Token)
sharedRules.description: Select one non-EPIC HERO SKRYRE CHARACTER model Once per battle, when a friendly SKRYRE unit within 6" of that model would resolve Warpstone Backlash, that model can expend the stockpile. If it does, ignore that instance of Warpstone Backlash. This does not prevent additional damage from Burn-Burn Warpstone! or other rules.

sharedRules.name: Overstuffed Power Cells (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: CLANRATS unit Change the RAPID FIRE 1 ability of Warplock carbines equipped by models in this unit to RAPID FIRE 2.

sharedRules.name: Voltaic Shield Amplifiers (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WARPCLAD unit Improve this unit's invulnerable save by 1, to a maximum of 4+. At the end of any phase in which this unit made one or more invulnerable saving throws, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Overclocked Servomotors (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WARPCLAD unit Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it. After this unit makes an Advance or Charge move, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: More-More Barrels! (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WEAPON TEAM unit Each time this unit is selected to shoot, you can re-roll any or all dice used to determine the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

sharedRules.name: Warpstone Supercharger (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WEAPON TEAM unit Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit. Those weapons have HAZARDOUS.

sharedRules.name: Unstable Power Regulators (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WEAPON TEAM unit Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. After this unit has shot, roll one D6. On a 1-2, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Warp-Lightning Capacitors (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: SKAVEN VEHICLE unit After this unit ends a Normal, Advance or Charge move, select one enemy unit within 6" and roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Emergency Warp-Shield (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: SKAVEN VEHICLE unit Once per battle, when this unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Reinforced-Ramshackle Hull (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: SKAVEN VEHICLE unit Add 1 to this unit's Toughness characteristic and subtract 1" from its Move characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Hidden Workshop (2 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: Unassigned Project After deployment, place one Hidden Workshop marker wholly within your deployment zone. While a friendly SKRYRE unit is within 6" of that marker, you can re-roll Hazardous tests taken for that unit. If an enemy unit ends any kind of move within 3" of that marker, remove it from the battlefield.

sharedRules.name: Warp-Blink Harnesses (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WARPCLAD unit Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit is not within Engagement Range, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it in the Under-Empire, even if it is not within range of a Knawhole. Then roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. This does not require or use a Knawhole.

sharedRules.name: More-More Power! (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WEAPON TEAM unit Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit. After it has shot, this unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Meltdown Protocol (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: WEAPON TEAM unit Once per battle, immediately after this unit has shot, it can shoot again. After it has shot for the second time, roll one D6: on a 1-2, this unit is destroyed; on a 3-5, this unit suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 6, nothing happens.

sharedRules.name: Overloaded Warp Reactor (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: SKAVEN VEHICLE unit Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1; add 1 to fixed Attacks characteristics of those weapons; and each time a random Attacks characteristic is determined for one of those weapons, you can re-roll one of those dice. All ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have HAZARDOUS until the end of the phase.

sharedRules.name: More-More Engines! (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: SKAVEN VEHICLE unit Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 2 to Advance rolls made for it. After this unit ends an Advance move, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Portable Knawhole Generator (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: Select one SKRYRE unit Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, if that unit is not within Engagement Range, place one friendly Knawhole wholly within 3" of that unit and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. Then roll one D6. On a 1, remove that Knawhole and the unit carrying the generator suffers D6 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Doomrocket Stockpile (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: Select one non-EPIC HERO WARLOCK CHARACTER model That model is equipped with a Doomrocket: Range 48"; Attacks D6+6; BS 4+; S 10; AP -2; D 2; BLAST, HAZARDOUS, INDIRECT FIRE, ONE SHOT, WARPSTONE.

sharedRules.name: Big-Big Guns For Big-Big Rats! (3 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: Select one STORMFIENDS unit That unit can purchase one Workshop Project from the Weapon Team Projects list as though it had the WEAPON TEAM keyword. It must be paid for normally, counts toward that unit's limit of 2 Workshop Projects, and does not otherwise grant the WEAPON TEAM keyword.

sharedRules.name: Brass Orb (4 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: Select one non-EPIC HERO SKRYRE CHARACTER model Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit within 12" and roll one D6: on a 1, the bearer suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 2-3, the target suffers D3+3 mortal wounds; on a 4-5, the target suffers D3+6 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked; on a 6, the target suffers 13 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked. The Brass Orb is then expended.

sharedRules.name: Doomsphere (6 Workshop Tokens)
sharedRules.description: Grand Project, Unique After deployment, secretly select one objective marker in No Man's Land and record it. Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase during battle rounds 3-5, you can detonate it. Units within 3" suffer 2D6+3 mortal wounds; units more than 3" and within 6" suffer D6+3 mortal wounds; units more than 6" and within 13" suffer D3 mortal wounds. Every surviving unit within 6" is then Battle-shocked. Until the start of your next Command phase, all models within range of that objective marker have OC 0. The objective marker remains on the battlefield.

Until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

ESHIN

Select one friendly ESHIN INFANTRY unit within 18". Until your next Command phase, models in that unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features as though they were not there; that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back; and it cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 12".
